0022600135.text: The Indiana Pacers, 2-2 and 3rd in the Central 1.5 games back, host the Philadelphia 76ers, who are 3-1 and 1st in the Atlantic, in the fifth game of Indiana's season. The Pacers are 0-1 at home and come off a loss, while the 76ers are 2nd in the East and have lost their last game. Indiana is without Andrew Nembhard (back soreness), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), with Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Joel Embiid (heel) and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen bruise) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers lost their 2025-26 season series 0-4, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
